Everything we do, and nothing we do not

We would rather do six things properly than list thirty. If you need something that is not on this page we will tell you who in Seattle does it well.

Same-day crowns

A scan replaces the tray of putty. The mill cuts the crown from a single block of ceramic while you wait, and Dr Okafor fits it the same morning.

Clear aligners

We take the scan, plan the movement and review it with you before anything is ordered.

  • Free consultation and scan
  • Payment plans over twelve or twenty four months
  • Retainers included for the first year

Emergency appointments

We hold two slots every weekday morning for people in pain. Telephone before nine and you will be seen the same day, whether or not you are already a patient here.
